purpose: Truth-free diagnosis of Phase67 base-correction misses. Distinguish exact SignalType matching from canonical same-frequency matching, out-of-domain time, missing satellite/frequency streams, and duplicate base observations without changing the frozen coverage gate or implementing a correction.

source_matching_contract.raw_adopted_proxy: MessageType=Raw; source timing finite; supported Android signal/frequency; valid positive raw-clock pseudorange; existing code/Cn0/multipath/state masks; one selected row per (epoch,satellite,SignalType)
source_matching_contract.raw_time: long-double (TimeNanos-first FullBiasNanos)/1e9 minus BiasNanos/1e9 and TimeOffsetNanos/1e9, with route epoch week unwrap
source_matching_contract.base_signal: RINEX observation band mapped by source signal_policy to SignalType; only finite positive code observations are considered
source_matching_contract.canonical_frequency_key: (GNSS system, SVID, physical carrier frequency/band; GLONASS channel retained)
source_matching_contract.time_domain: raw GPST epoch must lie within the first/last finite base sample for the same key; no extrapolation, endpoint hold, nearest fill, or gap repair
classification_precedence: exact SignalType stream exists: in_domain_exact or out_of_domain_time
canonical same-frequency stream exists but exact SignalType does not: in_domain_frequency_variant or out_of_domain_time
satellite has base streams but no canonical frequency: missing_frequency_stream
satellite has no base stream: missing_satellite_stream
source_matching_contract.duplicate_definition: at one base epoch, same satellite and canonical frequency has two or more finite code observations (including distinct RINEX tracking-code variants); report only, no arbitrary selection

decision_policy: Diagnostic counts are descriptive and cannot relax the Phase67 >=0.99 finite-correction or >=0.80 matched-factor policy. No canonicalization, interpolation change, base imputation, native implementation, solver run, or accuracy truth is authorized by this freeze. Any parser ambiguity, malformed input, hash mismatch, or nonfinite accounting fails closed.
